rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosted invoice page appears to be omitting the discount component entirely, either because the backend is not calculating/persisting a discount for this invoice or because the frontend invoice template is not rendering the discount field even when it exists. As a result, the totals area only shows line items and subtotal, with no discount row, blocking the test that verifies the discount base from observable UI output. Underlying error: TEST BLOCKED

The test could not be run — the invoice does not show a discount line or discount amount needed to verify the discount base.

Observations:
- The invoice INV-2026-00001 lists line items: Rental $315.00, Advance ($500.00), Replacement $75.00 and shows Subtotal ($110.00); no discount line or discount amount is visible.
- A page search for the word 'discount' returned no matches and the totals area (visible in the page and screenshot) does not include a discount entry, so the asserted comparisons cannot be performed.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Update the invoice rendering/calculation service so discounts are explicitly computed and displayed in the invoice totals section when applicable. Verify the backend returns discount fields for invoice INV-2026-00001, and ensure the UI template includes a visible discount line (label and amount) in the totals summary whenever the discount base is non-zero. If discounts are currently being applied only implicitly to subtotal or final total, change the invoice generation logic to expose them separately so the page content matches the expected test assertions. Also confirm the hosted data for this invoice includes the discount configuration/rate and that any caching layer is cleared after the fix.
